payload.text: hv 9 Nov (in molt-vc's session, asked and answered before the tag was pushed): the v1.4.6 tag stays at f2d262767020, which is vc's board commit 'wb(vc): commit vc's focus line...', not at its parent a7456a33 'release: v1.4.6'.
